description: Source code for the HdmiCec plugin handling HDMI CEC communication, event handling, and settings persistence within the WPEFramework environment.

classes.name: HdmiCec
classes.description: Main class implementing HDMI CEC plugin functionality, including event handling, settings management, and communication.

methods.name: HdmiCec::HdmiCec
methods.description: Constructor initializing plugin, registering methods, and loading settings.

methods.name: HdmiCec::~HdmiCec
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and deinitializing IARM.

methods.name: HdmiCec::InitializeIARM
methods.description: Initializes IARM bus and registers event handlers.

methods.name: HdmiCec::DeinitializeIARM
methods.description: Unregisters event handlers and cleans up IARM bus.

methods.name: HdmiCec::cecMgrEventHandler
methods.description: Handles CEC manager events such as daemon initialization and status updates.

methods.name: HdmiCec::dsHdmiEventHandler
methods.description: Handles HDMI hotplug events.

methods.name: HdmiCec::onCECDaemonInit
methods.description: Handles CEC daemon initialization event, toggling CEC enable state.

methods.name: HdmiCec::cecStatusUpdated
methods.description: Updates internal state based on CEC status updates, including logical address and device type.

methods.name: HdmiCec::onHdmiHotPlug
methods.description: Handles HDMI hotplug connect events, updating physical and logical addresses.

methods.name: HdmiCec::setEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for setting CEC enabled state via JSON RPC.

methods.name: HdmiCec::getEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for retrieving CEC enabled state via JSON RPC.

methods.name: HdmiCec::getCECAddressesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for retrieving CEC addresses via JSON RPC.

methods.name: HdmiCec::sendMessageWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for sending CEC message via JSON RPC.

methods.name: HdmiCec::loadSettings
methods.description: Loads CEC settings from persistent storage.

methods.name: HdmiCec::persistSettings
methods.description: Saves CEC settings to persistent storage.

methods.name: HdmiCec::setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables CEC functionality.

methods.name: HdmiCec::CECEnable
methods.description: Initializes CEC communication and acquires addresses.

methods.name: HdmiCec::CECDisable
methods.description: Disables CEC communication and cleans up resources.

methods.name: HdmiCec::getPhysicalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the physical address via CEC.

methods.name: HdmiCec::getLogicalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the logical address via CEC.

methods.name: HdmiCec::getEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether CEC is enabled.

methods.name: HdmiCec::setName
methods.description: Sets the device name (stub).

methods.name: HdmiCec::getName
methods.description: Returns device name, defaulting to 'STB'.

methods.name: HdmiCec::getCECAddresses
methods.description: Returns current CEC address info as JSON.

methods.name: HdmiCec::FromBase64String
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into bytes.

methods.name: HdmiCec::sendMessage
methods.description: Encodes and sends a CEC message.

methods.name: HdmiCec::cecAddressesChanged
methods.description: Notifies address change events.

methods.name: HdmiCec::notify
methods.description: Sends notification with CEC frame data.

methods.name: HdmiCec::onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages and sends notification.
